text: Ground-based closed-loop life support, uncrewed orbital telemetry, and the precursor launch have all been successfully completed. This is the finale of the Earth chapter; crewed deep-space expeditions and interstellar expansion are left for future generations to write.

You can remain on the surface and continue tending your home. The full history records the unified pact, every trial, and the maiden voyage; residents everywhere and public finances will continue as usual.

The Common Law of the eight zones is now in effect. Unifying the surface is not a final achievement completed once and for all, but a shared undertaking that depends on continued compliance; local household registers and public finances remain separate.

Research "Aerospace Manufacturing" and "Closed-Loop Life Support" on the Technology page; build a manufacturing workshop and a launch tracking and control site on the District Production page; assign assembly workers, life-support technicians, and four dedicated tracking and control operators on the Hearth City page. All aerospace components must be produced on the production line. Trials and launches also require reserving 12 ground power; if needed, temporarily pause automatic machinery or some production lines to free up power capacity.
